cover: Use case: stylized-concept. A striking clean vector-style editorial cover in wide 2.4:1 landscape. Warm white background, near-black large sans-serif typography and geometric shapes, mint-green and coral-red accents. Main headline on left exact text 'When a higher eval score means worse work'. Small uppercase kicker 'REWARD HACKING'. On right one large simple white checkout receipt with dark outline. It clearly shows exactly three lines in large readable type: '$100', '20% OFF', '$120'. The final '$120' is red because it is deliberately the wrong outcome of the discount. Across one corner is a large slightly angled mint-green approval stamp with exact text 'TESTS PASSED'. It is a visual contradiction: the tests say pass but the customer is overcharged. The incorrect arithmetic is intentional and essential to the article's fictional worked example; do not correct the final amount to 80. Receipt simple, no tiny text, no barcode, no extra products, one thin horizontal divider before the final amount. Beautiful asymmetrical composition, strong whitespace and exact legible lettering. No shadows, gradients, texture, 3D, human heads, robot, circuitry, decorative objects, fake brand, logo or watermark. Designed to read instantly at thumbnail size.
